script.body: Sab mujhe sirf ek strawberry samajhte hain. Par mera zipper kholo toh bunny nikal aayegi.
script.voiceover: Sab mujhe sirf ek strawberry samajhte hain. Par mera zipper kholo toh bunny nikal aayegi.
script.body_hi: सब मुझे सिर्फ एक strawberry समझते हैं। पर मेरा zipper खोलो तो bunny निकल आएगी।
script.voice_hi: सब मुझे सिर्फ एक strawberry समझते हैं। पर मेरा zipper खोलो तो bunny निकल आएगी।
script.meaning: Everyone thinks I am just a strawberry. But if you open my zipper, a bunny comes out.
script.scenes: The pink strawberry plush with tiny eyes and a mouth bounces happily on a soft surface.; The strawberry unzips smoothly to reveal the white bunny with long pink ears.

research.audience: Teens, young adults, or parents buying casual gifts or cozy room decor for ages 10+
research.problem: Looking for a unique, non-generic stuffed toy that doubles as a decorative accent for a desk or bed
research.buyer_moment: Packing a bag for a friend's birthday and showing them a plush that changes shape, or styling a desk setup for an IG story
research.surprise_detail: The unzipper transformation that turns a pink strawberry hood into a bunny with long ears
features: Exquisite embroidery of yellow strawberry seeds
research.best_angle: Surprise reveal: Start with the closed strawberry look, then rapidly unzip to show the bunny face popping out
research.people_reason: The core appeal is the mechanical zipper action and transformation, which requires hands to demonstrate clearly

script.facts: 34 cm height and 24 cm width; Reversible pillow design

style.label: product talks
style.brief: the PRODUCT is the speaker and talks in first person (main, mujhe, mera) to its owner, cute and a little cheeky. Line 1 = what it says on meeting the viewer, line 2 = a funny or sweet follow-up that shows what it is.
style.scene_rule: the product itself as a cute animated character with tiny eyes and a mouth, SAME shape and colours as in the reference image, bouncing and talking to the camera, no people, no text on screen.
style.voice_line: Voice: cute, playful character voice of the product itself, speaking everyday Hindi. Pronounce every word clearly and exactly as written, do not skip, merge or change any word.
style.yt_line: Vertical 10-second cute 3D animation: the product itself is a little character with tiny eyes and a mouth, same shape and colours as the reference photo, bouncing and talking to camera. Camera: slow macro push-in, playful mood.
style.look_extra: Camera: slow macro push-in, playful mood.
style.ad_brief: AD LEVEL = pure content: NO selling, no pitch, no praise, no 'buy'. It must feel like entertainment a person would share. The product just appears naturally in the scene; naming it is optional (this overrides any rule about naming it). PRICE RULE: do NOT mention any price, cost, discount, offer, 'cheap', 'cheapest' or 'budget' anywhere (no rupee amounts, no Rs, no numbers about money).
style.caption_tone: The caption must read like normal entertaining content (a relatable or funny line, a tiny story), NOT like an ad: do not list features or praise the product; mention it at most once in passing. Do not mention the price.
style.caption_cta: Comment LINK to get the link in your DM
style.trend: Viral line ideas (optional, adapt to the product, skip if they do not fit): Self-love, but make it cute / Adding to cart at 2 AM / Your boyfriend needs this too
style.overlay: Show big, clear on-screen text captions, spelled exactly: Me: no more shopping. Also me:, then Comment LINK, then Link in your DM.
